ideal: Trusted node:test suites: a test file per collector, engine module and tool, no unexplained skip, one CI test job green on main in minutes.

sources.title: Node.js Docs: Test runner (skip and todo)
Ham Vocke: The Practical Test Pyramid

quality: No test skipped or left todo, and the test job passing on main in 95% of runs or more.
speed: The test job finishes within the ten-minute build.
consumption: Billed test minutes no more than the one test job's speed goal.
